errors.evidence: The image does not show 'two sets of stacked bars' within a single chart. It shows two separate and complete charts side-by-side, both covering the same time period from 1991 to 2023. The description fundamentally misunderstands the figure's layout.

errors.text_span: Der zweite Satz, der die Jahre 2000 bis 2023 umfasst, besteht aus einem schwarzen Linienplot, der „Gebietskörperschaften insgesamt“ darstellt.
errors.evidence: This is a completely incorrect description of the right-hand chart. The right chart is also a stacked bar chart with a line plot over it, not just a line plot. Furthermore, it covers the years 1991-2023, not just 2000-2023.

errors.text_span: wobei die höchste Gesamthöhe um 1996 liegt
errors.evidence: The highest total value in the left chart is not around 1996 (which is approx. 2.9%). The peak is in 1991, with a value of approximately 3.2%.
The tick marks on the horizontal axis are not annual; the labels are shown for 1991, 1995, 2000, 2005, 2010, 2015, and 2023.
Due to the misinterpretation of the figure's structure, the description completely omits the stacked bars present in the right-hand chart, including the fact that some values are negative.
The description mentions the vertical dashed line but omits its important label, 'Bahnreform²', which is present on both charts.

The description does not mention the black line representing 'Gebietskörperschaften insgesamt' that is present on the left chart. It incorrectly associates this line only with its fabricated 'second set'.
